drafts.angle: Agent-native services firms need a judgment layer (rides @levie 'services firms… with agents at the center', 85.6K, 1.3K bookmarks, new today)
drafts.draft_en:
Aaron is right: the next great agencies get built with agents at the center.

But look at what changes.

Making the ad gets close to free. Agents ship 100 variants before lunch.

Knowing which ones should never go live does not. Brand rules, claims law, platform policy.

That expertise is the moat now. Approve, fix, or block. On every asset.
drafts.video_tip: 35s talking head, vertical. Open with Levie's post on screen for 2s, then a fast scroll of 20+ AI ad variants. Freeze on one and stamp APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK as you say the last line. Burned-in captions, native upload, credit @levie in the first reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Thankful this year for the people who build with me before it makes sense.

The teammates who stayed up through hackathon weekends. The people who said yes to an early demo. Everyone who told me what was broken.

Building Aubric is the hardest thing I've done, and the most fun.

Happy Thanksgiving.
